attchmntText: Arcotech Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: ARCOTECH Limited submitted newspaper publications of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The results were published in The Financial Express and Jansatta. The Board of Directors approved the results on 14 November 2026. ARCOTECH reported a net profit after tax of 237.59 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, the net profit after tax was 4,368.16 million. The company operates in the steel tubes segment. The results are subject to a limited review by statutory auditors. The full financial results are available on the company website. This filing complies with Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: Arcotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Arcotech Limited approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board met on 14th November 2026. The company reported a loss of 917.23 lakhs for the quarter and 1,732.79 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was 0.02 lakhs for both periods. Finance costs were 559.58 lakhs for the quarter and 1,119.48 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were negative 0.87 rupees for the quarter and negative 1.65 rupees for the half year. Total assets stood at 26,809.80 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The company entered settlement agreements with secured lenders as of 1st July 2026. The results were reviewed by the statutory auditors.
